title: Horse Warriors
description: A tragedy rocks Saddle Lake only one day before the big race; in the Rocky Mountain House, Logan shows up ready to compete.

title: North of 60
description: Lynx River is divided as Peter and Albert run in an election for chief; Eric realizes that he is losing touch with his kids.

title: APTN National News
description: Bringing news stories that matter to Indigenous Peoples.

title: APTN Investigates
description: The Shoal Lake 40 First Nation finally gets a road connecting residents to the rest of Canada.

title: Chums
description: Romper and Pterry accidentally disturb grumpy Mr. Wolverine. They try to avoid him but end up running into him again.

title: Lil' Glooscap and the Legend of Turtle Island
description: Lil Glooscap and friends learn that when something is done sooner rather than later, it can help solve or prevent a problem before it happens; actions in the present can sometimes make things easier in the future.

title: Indigenous Art Adventures
description: Follow along with Lance Cardinal to craft a mini tipi village; learn the Cree word of the day, nîpin, which means summer.

title: Anaana's Tent
description: Rita Claire shares her love of dancing and demonstrates the differences between eastern and western Arctic drum dancing; Emerald and Chad visit the qarmaq to perform a traditional drum dance, and the friends read Simonie and the Dance Contest.

title: Ukaliq and Kalla
description: Kalla and Ukaliq go berry picking for crowberries to make jam, with Ukaliq learning not to eat too many while picking; on a rainy day, the two stay inside their tent, where Kalla gets cleaning done and Ukaliq has fun playing ajagaq to pass the time.

title: Dreamcatchers
description: A young, inventive boy named Johnny is called to be a Dreamcatcher; like the others before him, he dreams that a large corporation is threatening his community's food supply; Johnny rushes to defend his home and discovers his ancestral powers.

title: Le petit Glooscap et les légendes de l'île de la Tortue
description: P'tit Glooscap et ses amis apprennent que les malentendus se produisent lorsque les gens n'écoutent pas ; afin de bien se comprendre, les gens doivent toujours écouter les deux versions d'une histoire.

title: Savoirs légendaires
description: À Kuujjuaq, Xavier et les enfants lancent des pierres à la manière du jeune Kautjajuq; dans le village michif de Saint-Laurent, avec l'aide de Jacinthe Lambert, les enfants fabriquent une pommade pour soulager les vilaines piqûres de maringouins.

title: La brigade
description: Sara veut que madame Labossière inscrive l'école à un colloque, mais la directrice impose la journée de la gentillesse afin que personne ne fasse de demande qu'elle devra refuser.

title: Nations des animaux
description: Dans les Territoires du Nord-Ouest, les chercheurs Tłı̨chǫ bravent les terres de la toundra pour protéger les caribous en s'appuyant sur les connaissances traditionnelles. Au Québec, les Innus enseignent aux jeunes leur lien sacré avec le caribou boréal.

title: Little Big Community
description: The Warm Springs people have thrived in Oregon's high desert for millennia; Elke and Jefferson are reconnecting with their ancestral lands and fighting for their rights to preserve their way of life linked to the Columbia River.

title: Animal Nation
description: Indigenous communities like the Kainai Blood Tribe revive their deep cultural and ecological ties to the bison with the help of Elk Island National Park, which reintroduces them to the prairies they roamed in vast herds before colonization.

title: Frozen Planet II
description: At the top of the planet lies the Arctic Ocean; after four months of winter darkness, the sun returns to reveal a frozen ocean covered in ice; mother polar bears emerge from their hillside dens and lead their cubs down to the sea ice to hunt.

title: Missing From Fire Trail Road
description: A documentary detailing the case of Mary Ellen Johnson-Davis, a Native American woman who disappeared in 2020. Her story exposes how hundreds of indigenous women continue to go missing in the USA, perpetuating trans-generational traumas.

title: Missing From Fire Trail Road
description: A documentary detailing the case of Mary Ellen Johnson-Davis, a Native American woman who disappeared in 2020. Her story exposes how hundreds of indigenous women continue to go missing in the USA, perpetuating trans-generational traumas.

title: Best in Miniature
description: The miniaturists try to strike the right note as they dress mini mannequins as their favorite pop icons and then find a home for their new outfits when they build a bedroom with a walk-in closet.

title: APTN National News Weekend
description: Bringing the week full circle with a recap of the top national news stories of the week.

title: APTN Investigates
description: For more than a century, Winnipeg has drawn its drinking water from Shoal Lake. Now, Shoal Lake 39 First Nation is suing the city and Ontario for $2 billion, alleging their home and way of life have paid the price. Christopher Read investigates.

title: Frozen Planet II
description: Found on every continent, mountains create unique frozen worlds, home to extraordinary animals that must overcome the crushing conditions of the cold.

title: Northwoods Survival
description: It's a return to a life free from the reliance on modern conveniences and away from the hustle and pollution of cities; it's a gamble that comes with a glorious upside, but also frighteningly high stakes.

title: Safe House
description: An FBI analyst must build an off-book safe house to get his job back, but his spirited contractor may prove to be more of a problem than a solution.

title: Mohawk Girls
description: Zoe perfects her cousin's wedding; Caitlin sees her dad in Butterhead; Anna ups her game.

title: Safe House
description: An FBI analyst must build an off-book safe house to get his job back, but his spirited contractor may prove to be more of a problem than a solution.

title: Rezervations for Two
description: Musician Ila, a serial monogamist, lets Kai and Scott set her up on a wine tasting date and a dinner date; just when she thinks the surprises are over, they reveal a third, unexpected date; will sparks fly, or will her heart be left playing solo once again?

title: North of North
description: Siaja helps with the community center's Elders' Night; she brings new ideas to the event; her changes are successful but lead to unforeseen results.

title: Coastal Carvings
description: The team prepares for a showcase featuring artist Levi; Jeremy collaborates on a rock engraving for the gallery entrance.

title: Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
description: Chuck travels to the lower Saint-Lawrence community of Wolastoqiyik to meet chef Maxime Lizotte and to fish sea urchins which are abundant in the Saint-Lawrence River. Chuck takes a boat and heads to the water to harvest this delicious seafood.

title: Wild Rose Vets
description: Dr. Allison and her team must monitor Shelby the Shih Tzu while trying to remove hundreds of tiny, grainy bladder stones; in Calgary, Dr. Emma and her team try to wrangle dogs for a blood drive.

title: APTN National News Weekend
description: Bringing the week full circle with a recap of the top national news stories of the week.

title: APTN Investigates
description: For more than a century, Winnipeg has drawn its drinking water from Shoal Lake. Now, Shoal Lake 39 First Nation is suing the city and Ontario for $2 billion, alleging their home and way of life have paid the price. Christopher Read investigates.

title: Nunami Piqatigiit: Tundra Friends
description: Tiu-Tiu gets frustrated when she struggles with reading and math; Sissy feels left out when her partners, Natti and Umi, plan the school project without her.

title: Tuktu
description: Tiri plans to go sledding with his friends, but right as he is leaving, his mom asks him to watch his siblings; Tiri is disappointed but wants to help his family; his friends offer to help babysit, and they all go sledding together.

title: Chums
description: A young girl and her furry friends travel across Turtle Island and embark on adventures that help them navigate their connections with each other, other animals and the environment.

title: The Magic Canoe
description: Nico makes others angry when he cries wolf to get their attention; an adventure makes Nico realize that crying wolf can have unpleasant consequences.

title: Indigenous Art Adventures
description: Host Lance Cardinal shows how to create fun beaver puppets; Lance also teaches the Cree word of the day, amisk, which means beaver; the beaver represents wisdom, one of the Seven Sacred Grandfather Teachings.

title: Coyote's Crazy Smart Science Show
description: Famous Indigenous aviators include Eula Pearl Carter Scott, who was the youngest pilot ever, and Wiley Post, who identified the jet stream; pilot John Herrington shares the science of aerodynamics; the Questers create a paper airplane.

title: Le petit Glooscap et les légendes de l'île de la Tortue
description: P'tit Glooscap et ses amis apprennent que les malentendus se produisent lorsque les gens n'écoutent pas ; afin de bien se comprendre, les gens doivent toujours écouter les deux versions d'une histoire.

title: La brigade
description: Sara et ses amies tournent une vidéo pour le cours de français, et Laboss est persuadée qu'elles en profitent pour rire d'elle. Éric se retrouve dans une compétition de mathématiques athlétique avec Tommy.

title: Capteurs de rêves
description: Économiser protège du besoin; lorsque les Capteurs de rêves saisissent un rêve dans lequel quelqu'un empoisonne un lac sacré, ils doivent trouver le Rêveur, débloquer ses superpouvoirs ancestraux et empêcher le rêve de se réaliser.

title: Kiuna, plus qu'une école
description: C'est la dernière semaine de cours de la session d'hiver et les étudiants affronteront sous peu la période des examens ; pour les motiver, Lisa-Marie organise un repas collectif et un gala méritas.

title: Red River Gold
description: A promising spot on the hunt for gold is also central to Roger's family history - where a tragedy would have wiped them out in an instant but for the help of one man. The team meets his great-great-granddaughter.

title: Searchers
description: Gary Pelletier, 63, vanishes from Fort Qu'Appelle; the search for him highlights the challenges of finding vulnerable people.

title: Water Worlds
description: Once thought extinct, glass sponge reefs are rediscovered in the 1980s deep off Canada's West Coast; scientists and researchers need specialized deep-sea technology to study these ancient and fragile ecosystems.

title: The Nature of Things
description: Thirty years after historic logging protests on Vancouver Island, the battle to protect old-growth forests is still raging.

title: Life Below Zero
description: During the heart of winter, Alaskans face unforeseen challenges in a dog-sled race, alter their strategies for hunting on the tundra and break through a wall of ice on the Yukon River.

title: Racing Waters
description: At Seabird Island, we meet the Island Brave and the world of Indigenous war canoe racing; as the team begins the new racing season, and with Brazil looming ahead for several paddlers, culture, competition, and legacy come together.

title: Northern Air Rescue
description: It's early in the forest fire season and remote northern First Nations are already being evacuated. To respond to the needs of the communities under threat, Missinippi Airways trains more pilots on their newest plane, so they can fly more emergency cargo.

title: Safe House
description: An FBI analyst must build an off-book safe house to get his job back, but his spirited contractor may prove to be more of a problem than a solution.

title: Northwoods Survival
description: It's a return to a life free from the reliance on modern conveniences and away from the hustle and pollution of cities; it's a gamble that comes with a glorious upside, but also frighteningly high stakes.

title: APTN Investigates: A Retrospective
description: Reporter Kathleen Martens travels across the country to speak with those impacted by the Indian Residential Schools Settlement Agreement.

title: Life Below Zero
description: Early melting ice forces inhabitants to move their camp out of danger; the residents teach critical survival skills, stockpile resources and brave the uncertain tundra to transport a key piece of equipment.
